_doc.purpose: Reactions of the character being undressed / redressed by someone else (Data/COM_Defs/COM_wardrobe.json). <id>_Begin = accepted, <id> with requireEPFailure = refused, <id> otherwise = done. Self undress / redress is silent: kojo never fires on a self target. Redress is always accepted, so it has no refusal; every redress layer and undress-all redirect to a shared entry.

zh-cn.com_undress_outer_Begin_A_1: $self$轻轻抬起手臂，配合着$target$的动作，嘴角带着一点笑意。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_Begin_A_2: “热了吗……还是想看我穿得少一点？”$self$小声说着，没有躲开。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_Begin_B_1: $self$僵在原地，咬着嘴唇任由$target$的手伸向自己的外衣。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_Begin_B_2: $self$的肩膀微微发抖，却不敢开口拒绝。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_Begin_C_1: “诶？等、等一下……”$self$有些慌乱，最后还是没有阻止。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_Begin_C_2: $self$别过脸去，犹豫了一下才松开了抓着外衣的手。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_D_1: $self$在睡梦中毫无察觉，只是翻了个身，外衣被轻轻褪了下来。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_D_2: $self$呼吸平稳，完全没有发现自己的外衣已经被脱掉了。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_E_1: $self$凝固在原地，外衣被脱下时连一根手指都没有动。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_E_2: 时间静止中的$self$宛如人偶，任由$target$取走了外衣。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_F_1: “现在不行啦，待会儿好不好？”$self$笑着按住了$target$的手。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_G_1: “诶！？突然干什么啦！”$self$红着脸后退了一步。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_H_2: $self$冷冷地瞪着$target$，把外衣裹得更紧了。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_I_1: $self$理了理头发，大方地让$target$接过脱下的外衣。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_J_1: 外衣被脱下后，$self$环抱着双臂，眼眶有些发红。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_J_2: $self$低着头，一言不发地站在那里。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_K_1: $self$不太自在地拉了拉剩下的衣服，脸上有些发烫。
zh-cn.com_undress_outer_K_2: “……就只是外衣而已吧？”$self$小声嘀咕着。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_Begin_A_1: $self$红着脸，主动解开了衣服的扣子。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_Begin_A_2: “轻一点……”$self$低声说着，乖乖抬起了手臂。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_Begin_B_1: $self$紧闭双眼，身体僵硬地任由$target$剥下衣服。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_Begin_B_2: $self$的手指揪着衣角，最终还是无力地松开了。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_Begin_C_1: “真、真的要脱吗……？”$self$满脸通红，却没有逃开。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_Begin_C_2: $self$低着头，任由$target$的手碰到自己的衣服。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_D_1: $self$睡得正沉，对衣服被脱下毫无反应，只是轻轻哼了一声。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_D_2: $self$在睡梦中缩了缩身子，似乎觉得有点冷。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_E_1: $self$维持着静止前的表情，衣服被脱下也毫无知觉。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_E_2: $self$一动不动，任凭$target$摆布着自己的衣物。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_F_1: “这个……还是等晚上再说吧？”$self$害羞地按住了衣角。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_G_1: “你、你在想什么啊！”$self$满脸通红地护住了胸口。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_G_2: $self$慌张地后退：“我们还没到那种关系吧！？”
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_I_1: 只剩贴身衣物的$self$害羞地抱住自己，眼神却偷偷瞄着$target$。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_J_1: $self$用双手遮挡着身体，泪水在眼眶里打转。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_J_2: $self$蜷缩着身子，肩膀不住地颤抖。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_K_1: $self$红着脸遮住身体，不敢看$target$的眼睛。
zh-cn.com_undress_inner_K_2: “别、别一直盯着看啦……”$self$扭过身去。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_Begin_A_1: $self$呼吸有些急促，轻轻点了点头，任由$target$褪去最后的遮挡。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_Begin_B_2: $self$浑身发抖，徒劳地想要并拢双腿。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_Begin_C_1: $self$的脸红到了耳根，双手不知道该往哪里放。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_Begin_C_2: “呜……”$self$发出细小的声音，却没有阻止$target$。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_D_1: $self$毫无防备地睡着，连最后的贴身衣物也被褪了下来。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_D_2: $self$在睡梦中轻轻呢喃，对自己被剥光一无所知。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_E_1: $self$一丝不挂地凝固在原地，脸上仍是静止前的神情。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_E_2: 毫无知觉的$self$任由$target$褪下了最后的贴身衣物。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_F_1: “对不起……这个真的还不行。”$self$紧紧按住了最后的遮挡。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_F_2: $self$红着脸摇头：“再、再给我一点时间……”
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_G_1: “不行不行不行！”$self$羞得几乎要哭出来。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_H_1: “你敢！”$self$的眼神里充满了愤怒与警惕。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_H_2: $self$狠狠地瞪着$target$，死死护住了身体。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_I_1: 一丝不挂的$self$害羞地望着$target$，眼中带着期待。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_I_2: “……接下来，你想做什么？”$self$小声问道。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_J_1: $self$徒劳地用双手遮掩着赤裸的身体，抽泣个不停。
zh-cn.com_undress_skin_K_1: $self$满脸通红地遮住身体，羞得说不出话来。
zh-cn.com_redress_Begin_A_1: $self$乖乖地伸出手臂，让$target$帮自己穿上衣服。
zh-cn.com_redress_Begin_A_2: “嘿嘿，被照顾的感觉真不错。”$self$笑着说。
zh-cn.com_redress_Begin_B_1: $self$有些意外，但还是配合着穿上了衣服。
zh-cn.com_redress_Begin_B_2: “我、我自己来就好……”$self$嘴上这么说，却没有拒绝。
zh-cn.com_redress_D_1: $self$仍在熟睡，完全没发现自己被穿上了衣服。
zh-cn.com_redress_D_2: $self$在梦中翻了个身，衣服已被整理妥当。
zh-cn.com_redress_E_1: $self$凝固在原地，被穿好了衣服也毫无知觉。
zh-cn.com_redress_E_2: 静止的$self$像人偶一样被$target$打扮整齐。
zh-cn.com_redress_I_1: $self$低头看了看穿好的衣服，开心地笑了。

en-us.com_undress_outer_Begin_A_1: $self$ lifts her arms to help $target$, a small smile on her lips.
en-us.com_undress_outer_Begin_A_2: "Too warm? ...Or do you just want me in fewer clothes?" $self$ murmurs, not pulling away.
en-us.com_undress_outer_Begin_B_1: $self$ freezes, biting her lip as $target$'s hand reaches for her outerwear.
en-us.com_undress_outer_Begin_B_2: $self$'s shoulders tremble, but she doesn't dare to refuse.
en-us.com_undress_outer_Begin_C_1: "Eh? W-wait..." $self$ flusters, but in the end doesn't stop it.
en-us.com_undress_outer_Begin_C_2: $self$ looks away, hesitating before she lets go of her outerwear.
en-us.com_undress_outer_D_1: $self$ sleeps on, oblivious, only rolling over as her outerwear slips off.
en-us.com_undress_outer_D_2: $self$ breathes steadily, unaware her outerwear is already gone.
en-us.com_undress_outer_E_1: $self$ stays frozen in place, not a finger moving as her outerwear comes off.
en-us.com_undress_outer_E_2: Like a doll in stopped time, $self$ lets $target$ take her outerwear.
en-us.com_undress_outer_F_1: "Not right now, okay? Later." $self$ laughs, catching $target$'s hand.
en-us.com_undress_outer_F_2: $self$ gently pushes $target$ away. "This isn't a good place..."
en-us.com_undress_outer_G_1: "Huh!? What are you doing all of a sudden!" $self$ steps back, red-faced.
en-us.com_undress_outer_G_2: $self$ clutches her collar in a panic. "N-no way!"
en-us.com_undress_outer_H_2: $self$ glares coldly at $target$, pulling her outerwear tighter.
en-us.com_undress_outer_I_1: $self$ fixes her hair and casually lets $target$ take the outerwear.
en-us.com_undress_outer_I_2: "Thanks, hold onto that for me." $self$ smiles.
en-us.com_undress_outer_J_1: With her outerwear gone, $self$ hugs herself, eyes reddening.
en-us.com_undress_outer_J_2: $self$ stands there with her head down, saying nothing.
en-us.com_undress_outer_K_1: $self$ awkwardly tugs at what she's still wearing, her face warm.
en-us.com_undress_outer_K_2: "...It's just the outer layer, right?" $self$ mutters.
en-us.com_undress_inner_Begin_A_1: Blushing, $self$ undoes the buttons of her clothes herself.
en-us.com_undress_inner_Begin_B_1: $self$ squeezes her eyes shut, stiff as $target$ strips off her clothes.
en-us.com_undress_inner_Begin_B_2: $self$'s fingers clutch the hem, then limply let go.
en-us.com_undress_inner_Begin_C_1: "Y-you really want to take it off...?" $self$ is bright red, but doesn't run.
en-us.com_undress_inner_Begin_C_2: $self$ lowers her head and lets $target$'s hands reach her clothes.
en-us.com_undress_inner_D_1: $self$ sleeps deeply, only letting out a soft hum as her clothes come off.
en-us.com_undress_inner_D_2: $self$ curls up in her sleep, as if feeling a little cold.
en-us.com_undress_inner_E_1: $self$ keeps the expression she had when time stopped, unaware of her clothes coming off.
en-us.com_undress_inner_E_2: $self$ stays perfectly still as $target$ handles her clothes.
en-us.com_undress_inner_F_1: "This... let's save it for tonight, okay?" $self$ shyly holds her hem in place.
en-us.com_undress_inner_F_2: $self$ shakes her head, blushing. "Not right now..."
en-us.com_undress_inner_G_1: "Wh-what are you thinking!" $self$ covers her chest, face burning.
en-us.com_undress_inner_G_2: $self$ backs away in a panic. "We're not like that yet!?"
en-us.com_undress_inner_H_2: $self$ shakes off $target$'s hand in disgust. "Don't even think about it."
en-us.com_undress_inner_I_1: Down to her underwear, $self$ shyly hugs herself, sneaking glances at $target$.
en-us.com_undress_inner_J_1: $self$ covers herself with both hands, tears welling up.
en-us.com_undress_inner_J_2: $self$ curls in on herself, shoulders trembling.
en-us.com_undress_inner_K_1: $self$ covers herself, face red, unable to meet $target$'s eyes.
en-us.com_undress_skin_Begin_A_1: Breathing a little faster, $self$ nods and lets $target$ remove the last thing covering her.
en-us.com_undress_skin_Begin_A_2: "...Only you get to see this." $self$ whispers, blushing.
en-us.com_undress_skin_Begin_B_1: $self$ grits her teeth as tears silently roll down.
en-us.com_undress_skin_Begin_B_2: $self$ trembles all over, uselessly trying to keep her legs together.
en-us.com_undress_skin_Begin_C_1: $self$ goes red to the tips of her ears, not knowing what to do with her hands.
en-us.com_undress_skin_Begin_C_2: "Nnh..." $self$ makes a tiny sound, but doesn't stop $target$.
en-us.com_undress_skin_D_1: $self$ sleeps defenselessly as even her underwear is slipped off.
en-us.com_undress_skin_D_2: $self$ murmurs in her sleep, unaware she's been stripped bare.
en-us.com_undress_skin_E_1: $self$ stands frozen and completely naked, still wearing the expression from before time stopped.
en-us.com_undress_skin_E_2: Unaware, $self$ lets $target$ slip off the last of her underwear.
en-us.com_undress_skin_F_1: "Sorry... this one, not yet." $self$ holds her last layer firmly in place.
en-us.com_undress_skin_F_2: $self$ shakes her head, blushing. "G-give me a little more time..."
en-us.com_undress_skin_G_1: "No no no no!" $self$ is so embarrassed she's almost in tears.
en-us.com_undress_skin_H_1: "Don't you dare!" $self$'s eyes are full of anger and wariness.
en-us.com_undress_skin_H_2: $self$ glares daggers at $target$, guarding her body with everything she has.
en-us.com_undress_skin_I_1: Completely naked, $self$ looks shyly at $target$, eyes full of anticipation.
en-us.com_undress_skin_I_2: "...So, what do you want to do next?" $self$ asks softly.
en-us.com_undress_skin_J_1: $self$ hopelessly tries to cover her bare body with her hands, sobbing.
en-us.com_undress_skin_J_2: $self$ curls into a ball, whimpering quietly.
en-us.com_undress_skin_K_1: $self$ covers herself, face crimson, too embarrassed to speak.
en-us.com_undress_skin_K_2: "Uuu... y-you saw everything..." $self$ hides her face.
en-us.com_redress_Begin_A_1: $self$ obediently holds out her arms so $target$ can help her get dressed.
en-us.com_redress_Begin_A_2: "Hehe, being taken care of feels nice." $self$ smiles.
en-us.com_redress_Begin_B_1: $self$ looks a little surprised, but goes along and lets herself be dressed.
en-us.com_redress_Begin_B_2: "I-I can do it myself..." $self$ says, but doesn't refuse.
en-us.com_redress_D_1: $self$ is still fast asleep, unaware she's been dressed.
en-us.com_redress_D_2: $self$ rolls over in her dreams, her clothes already put back in order.
en-us.com_redress_E_1: $self$ stays frozen in place, unaware of being dressed.
en-us.com_redress_E_2: Motionless, $self$ is dressed up neatly by $target$ like a doll.
en-us.com_redress_I_1: $self$ looks down at her clothes and smiles happily.
en-us.com_redress_K_1: $self$ lets out a breath of relief and straightens her clothes.
